gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-meetei: Bushcraft spreads out its closed, constant-stroke letters with wide gaps, and its capitals hardly rise above the lowercase. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek sits beside it with large, open lowercase and rounds that look cracked like a bangle.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mende-: Loose, wide-set and hand-made in spirit, Bushcraft keeps every stroke the same weight, even on its crossbarred t. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui runs on with daylight in every curve, its lowercase standing tall.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-meroit: Bushcraft draws every line as if with a ruler, one constant width, and spaces its letters far apart for a stretched-out look. Noto Sans Meroitic sits below, friendly and open.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-modi: No stroke in Bushcraft ever swells or thins, so its closed letters look drawn with a single, steady pen. Noto Sans Modi opens every curve to the light, and over a full page its lowercase stays close to cap height, which keeps lines easy to follow.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono sets sturdy, tall lowercase with generous gaps. Bushcraft is the showman, closed letters with no thick-to-thin shading, while the mono body simply keeps its open curves and spacing tidy.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs dense, tall words with wide entrances into every letter, a very different texture from its partner. Bushcraft earns its place big and brief.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-multan: Noto Sans Multani brings a lofty x-height and an e with a wide gap at its end, built for running text. Bushcraft, with its closed shapes and extra-wide spacing, is happiest making a bold, artistic statement.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-myanma: Wide, artistic and strokes that never swell, Bushcraft turns every letter into a closed, uniform shape. Noto Sans Myanmar does the steady work, a heavy-looking band of text with a broad, welcoming c.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-nabata: Spacious and a bit wild, Bushcraft pairs closed, constant-weight letters with extra-wide gaps for an expressive look. Noto Sans Nabataean handles the plain sans work, its almost cap-tall lowercase and wide-open s keeping text direct.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-nag-mu: Noto Sans Nag Mundari has c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, with lowercase rivaling the capitals. Noto Sans Nag Mundari keeps a long stretch of text clear and sturdy, while Bushcraft stays closed and stretched.
